candidate.title: Collective booking can report success while silently skipping co-host calendar creation when destination credential is missing
reports: packages/core/eventmanager.ts:370 — per-host creation failures are accumulated without propagation or compensation, so a collective booking can succeed after only some host calendars were created
packages/core/eventmanager.ts:356 — when the credential row exists but app.slug is null the credential stays undefined and that destination calendar is skipped silently with no log or failure result

packages/core/eventmanager.ts:369 — when a destination's credential cannot be resolved, that host is skipped with no failed eventresult, so their calendar event and booking reference go missing and nothing is logged or reported.

packages/core/eventmanager.ts:370 — sequential awaited createevent per destination with swallowed errors (createevent returns success:false, 404 → undefined) means a failed co-host calendar is dropped from createdevents with no reference or error surfaced, reporting the booking fully synced (p2, conf 60)

silent skip in eventmanager.createallcalendarevents (packages/core/eventmanager.ts:~341-365): when a destination's credentialid is set but the credential is neither in this.calendarcredentials nor found in the db, the if (credential) block simply doesn't run — no else, no log, no failure result — so a host whose credential was deleted/disconnected gets no calendar event and no trace while the booking completes 'successfully'

packages/core/eventmanager.ts:369 — [p1, confidence 100] if (credential) { const createdevent = await createevent(credential, event, destination.externalid); ... } silently emits no result when a collective host's referenced credential is missing, so the booking passes the results.length > 0 failure checks and reports success while dropping that host's calendar event; although skipping a deleted credential avoids aborting other hosts, the absence of an error result makes the partial failure invisible and therefore remains defective.
